- Filing Status: Married filing jointly in Chicago, IL
- W-2 Income: $82,350 (Midwest Health Systems)
- Additional Income: $12,500 (freelance graphic design, 4 clients)

4. What specific tax forms will be needed to file correctly?

Thank you!
